summary: Re-derived the standalone homily against both studies as their re-authoring (study iterations 3-7, concise 3-4) and fresh cold reviews left them, after the independent visual review returned the run to the study. Of the seven inputs the homily's accepted review sealed, only the shared format.tex had changed, and its new running-head discipline does not govern this document, which sets its own right head; the proof's auxiliary file is byte-identical to iteration 4's, so no line, page break or reference moved. Every attribution, quotation, locus and disclosed source route of the speech and its terminal note was re-read against the current studies and the tracked sources behind them, and the four changes to the study's argument were each followed into the speech and found not to reach it, so the spoken body stands unchanged at 1,429 words. Two edits: the terminal note now gives the second reviewed reading its whole title, the study having declared the short form as a running head distinct from that title, and the spoken body's header comment now counts and names its five movements as the leaf's own audit numbers them, clearing the standing HOM-009 advisory. The proof is five physical pages, letter, reproducible byte for byte, with a clean log and every homily-edition preflight check passing.
